subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should no-pluginId, no-code persisted diagnostics with missing absolute sources be invalidated at runtime as part of this PR, or should that legacy cleanup move to doctor/migration-owned repair code?
rationale: Root policy treats persisted-state compatibility and runtime fallbacks as upgrade-sensitive, and the new legacy branch intentionally changes current upgrade behavior outside the explicit new diagnostic marker path.

options.title: Require proof and accept runtime fallback
options.body: Ask for raw legacy-upgrade proof, then accept the narrow runtime invalidation for no-code missing-source rows if the proof shows startup proceeds.

options.title: Accept source and tests now
options.body: Maintainers can waive the remaining real-behavior proof gap and rely on source inspection plus regression tests for the upgrade path.

options.title: Move legacy repair out of runtime
options.body: Pause this PR and require the legacy no-code cleanup to live in doctor or migration-owned repair code instead.

recommendation.title: Require proof and accept runtime fallback
recommendation.body: Ask for raw legacy-upgrade proof, then accept the narrow runtime invalidation for no-code missing-source rows if the proof shows startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: He gave the predecessor's explicit-marker direction and is the most recent owner visible in the touched plugin registry and discovery paths.
